notes: v587 — GRADING NOW HEALS ITSELF. When the very first grade of a day ran past our 120-second patience, the radar used to give up and sit there with dashes until you pressed try again — even though the server usually finishes the compute moments later and the next ask returns instantly. Now: every failure records its reason (timeout, network, or the server's own words), the note speaks it, and for timeouts and network blips the app quietly asks again by itself — up to twice, 45 seconds apart, with a live countdown ticking on screen so you can watch it self-heal. Rate-limit failures are never auto-retried (that would just burn the limit). Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
